ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous regions located on the distal halves of the left and right lobes; the left lobe displays dense low-intensity (black) mottling and speckling within the white field, while the right lobe shows a more uniform white field with sparse dark spots and one distinct vertical linear disruption.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern visible along the entire trailing edge span, characterized by small jagged peaks and shallow valleys with a pixel amplitude of 3-7 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory extending from the median notch toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast irregular clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; small, circular low-intensity (dark) focal points present on the right distal white patch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear marks (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear scarring on the left lobe; jagged, irregular distal tip boundaries suggesting physical trauma or extensive barnacle attachment; focal dark lesion on the right lobe white field.
other_distinctive_markers: Leading edge (proximal) is partially obscured by high-intensity water splash/turbulence.
